prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and which parts of marketing you want powered by AI (creative generation, ad/bid optimization, customer analytics, personalization, predictive modeling, etc.).

To help quickly: tell me these details and I’ll build a tailored short‑list and comparison (pricing, case studies, tech stack, recommended contract length):

- Your primary goal (brand awareness, lead gen, direct response, e‑commerce growth, personalization, chatbots, etc.)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget
- Industry (B2B, B2C, e‑commerce, healthcare, finance, etc.)
- Preferred agency size (boutique vs large network)
- Timeline (immediate campaign vs long-term program)
- Any must‑have services or tech (Google/Meta ads, CRM integration, first‑party data, generative AI creative, analytics)

If you want a quick, general starting point, here are five LA agencies known for combining data/AI and marketing (I can validate recent work and fit for you):

- R/GA — large, innovation- and data-driven creative agency; strong in brand + tech solutions.  
- AKQA — global digital agency with AI-driven product and experience capabilities.  
- VaynerMedia — strong in social, creative and performance; uses data/AI for targeting and creative testing.  
- Wpromote — LA-based performance marketing agency with AI-driven media optimization and analytics.  
- Tinuiti — performance and commerce-focused, uses automation and ML for ad optimization and ROAS.

If you want, I’ll research these plus 5–7 more boutique AI-first shops in LA, compare them against your needs, and recommend the top 2 fits. Which option do you prefer?
